decision.explanation: Each of these answers refers to a distinct individual named 'Governor Olson' in separate documents. Document D1S2 identifies Allen I. Olson as a Republican; D2S4 identifies Floyd B. Olson as a member of the Minnesota Farmer-Labor Party; and D3S2 identifies Culbert Olson as a member of the Democratic Party. Since each refers to a different person with the same title ('Governor Olson'), they are distinct valid answers.
